phase_name: Widen the Chunk Boundary Without Widening the Harvested Name Set

objectives.description: Re-derive three declaration-alternation sites by pattern
Define widened boundary alternation once, beside the shared identifier pattern
Apply widened boundary at all three sites (do_check, extract_r1, extract_r2)
Separate name-harvest filter from boundary match in extract_r1/extract_r2
Separate body-forcing filter from boundary match
Update extract_r1 header comment to state the new policy
Add failing-first test case R11 (abbrev between two theorems)
Add failing-first test case R12 (anonymous instance between two theorems)
Add regression assertion R13 (abbrev contributes no name)
Demonstrate R11/R12 fail before, pass after

notes: All edits landed in the source store (~/.config/nvim); files_touched intentionally empty here, same cross-repo rationale as Phases 1-2. Three-role decoupling: LEAN_DECL_BOUNDARY_KW (theorem|lemma|def|instance|abbrev, optional name) for the boundary match; LEAN_DECL_NAME_KW (theorem|lemma|def|instance) + name-present gates name-harvest and body-forcing identically via an is_forced() predicate. Suite rose from 19 to 22 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. R11/R12 confirmed red against the Phase-2 commit (sha 330a9309c) -- both exited 0 but the abbrev/instance text was entirely absent from the assembled module, the swallowing defect itself -- and green after this phase's edits. Source-store commit sha 7626d37a9. The two foreign uncommitted files (ladder-counter-observables.md, index-entries.json) remain untouched.
